entity.summary: Ethereum layer-2 order-book decentralized exchange launched in June 2020. On 2022-07-13 DeversiFi became rhino.fi as the project expanded from a pure-play exchange into a broader multi-chain DeFi platform.
entity.notes: First-party rhino.fi retrospectives establish that DeversiFi was unveiled on 2020-06-03 as an Ethereum layer-2 exchange and later describe it explicitly as an orderbook DEX. On 2022-07-13 the project announced that DeversiFi became rhino.fi and shifted toward a broader multi-chain DeFi gateway. HEI classifies the historical DeversiFi exchange identity as rebranded rather than dead. No successor_id is assigned in this batch because current rhino.fi has evolved beyond a pure exchange into broader bridging, stablecoin and infrastructure products; forcing a canonical exchange lineage edge would overstate scope continuity.

events.title: DeversiFi launched as an Ethereum layer-2 exchange
events.description: DeversiFi was unveiled on 2020-06-03 as an Ethereum layer-2 protocol focused on gas-free, scalable trading.
events.notes: The date comes from a first-party one-year retrospective published on 2021-06-03.

events.title: DeversiFi became rhino.fi
events.description: DeversiFi announced that it had become rhino.fi, changing the project identity while expanding from a pure-play layer-2 exchange into a broader multi-chain DeFi platform.
events.notes: This is a rebrand and product-scope transition, not an insolvency, exploit or service-failure event.

evidence.title: 1 year helping DeFi scale
evidence.notes: First-party retrospective states that DeversiFi was unveiled on 2020-06-03 and records $300 million traded in its first year.

evidence.title: Introducing rhino.fi: A Frictionless Gateway to Multi-chain DeFi
evidence.notes: First-party announcement states: today DeversiFi becomes rhino.fi, and explains the move from layer-2 trading toward a broader multi-chain DeFi platform.

evidence.title: Plan for DVF purchase
evidence.notes: First-party retrospective describes DeversiFi as an orderbook DEX that began in June 2020 and says the project later pivoted to rhino.fi while deprioritizing the DEX, supporting the historical exchange-to-broader-platform scope transition.
